title: Quantum algorithms for compact polymer thermodynamics
summary: Efficient sampling from ensembles of Hamiltonian cycles is critical for predicting the thermodynamic properties of compact polymers, with applications including modeling protein and RNA folding and designing soft materials. Although classical Monte Carlo methods are widely regarded as the standard approach, their efficiency is strongly limited when applied to compact polymers. In this work, we enable a quadratic speedup in the estimation of thermodynamic properties of maximally compact polymers and heteropolymers by quantum computation.
